text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0908 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50 to C$1.00 higher on Tuesday's Statistics Canada stocks report which forecast canola March 31 stocks at 2.025 million tonnes. Many traders expected a larger on farm number. July WCE futures crush margin fell to -11.02 Monday from -2.75 Friday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3866 versus the U.S. dollar and rose to 85.98 Japanese Yen and fell to 1.2243 German Marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 up in the July with support seen from tighter than expected StatsCan stocks report.

WESTERN BARLEY - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on StatsCan's report showing a faster drawdown of on farm stocks at 5.825 million tonnes by March 31 compared to the same time the year before at 6.848 million tonnes, despite larger production in the current crop year. Ending stocks were seen down to 3.0 million tonnes compared to trade expectations of 3.6 to 3.9 million tonnes.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 down on StatsCan's larger-than-expected on farm stocks estimate.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
